# ConvUnit — Unit Converter

> Free online unit converter with 123 units across 23 categories and 12 languages. 48,925 pages of conversion tools, formulas, and reference data.

## What is ConvUnit?

ConvUnit is a multilingual unit conversion website covering 17 converter categories (length, weight, temperature, data storage, area, volume, speed, time, pressure, energy, power, fuel efficiency, frequency, angle, force, torque, shoe size) and 6 interactive calculators (number base, unix timestamp, percentage, BMI, age, currency).

## Key Features

- 123 units, 433 conversion pairs
- 12 languages: English, 中文, Español, Français, Deutsch, 日本語, Português, Italiano, 한국어, Русский, हिन्दी, Türkçe
- Value-in-URL pages: every conversion has its own SEO-optimized page
- Real-time interactive converter with instant results
- Common conversion tables on every pair page
- Cross-links between related categories and units
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Free, no registration, no ads blocking content

## URL Structure

- Homepage: `/{lang}/`
- Category: `/{lang}/{category}/`
- Converter pair: `/{lang}/{category}/{unit1}-to-{unit2}/`
- Value conversion: `/{lang}/{category}/{value}-{unit1}-to-{unit2}/`
- Example: `/en/length/km-to-miles/` or `/en/length/5-km-to-miles/`

## Conversion API (Informal)

Every page includes:
- The conversion formula (e.g., "1 km = 0.621371 miles")
- Common values table
- Unit descriptions with historical/contextual information
- FAQ with direct answers
